name: Arc Side Gaiden 2: Mahou to Yuujou
original_name: アークサイド 外伝２【魔法と友情】
source:
A group of four continue to travel together. They run into problems and heroically overcome them. Even trifle matters can turn into a wonderful adventure...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
四人继续结伴旅行，遭遇难题，再英勇地将其克服。即便是微不足道的小事，也能化作一场精彩的冒险……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
